data.action: 海边祭典摊位举起捞到的星星面具，半扎发在灯笼与海风里轻摇
data.description: 【夏日祭海滨摊位·傍晚】有希穿着紫白泳装外搭轻薄浴衣短衫，坐在海边祭典的捞面具摊旁挑选纪念品；她把捞到的星星面具举给镜头，半扎发被灯笼和海风照得轻轻摇曳。
data.lighting: lantern glow mixed with blue evening sea light
data.mood: 宅系少女的海滨约会活力
data.promptProse: Yuki Suou from Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian wears a violet-and-white swimsuit with a short yukata jacket, ribbon hair tie and a star festival mask. She sits at the seaside festival stall with a star-shaped mask balanced in both hands. She turns the prize toward the viewer, half-up black hair moving between lantern light and sea breeze as her perfect-lady composure gives way to genuine excitement. lantern glow mixed with blue evening sea light.
data.title: 周防有希 · 海滨捞面具的夏日约会
